vault.deviceVaultPhilosophy: The device is not the cartridge. The cartridge is not the dose. The dose is not the plan. Device identity, inventory, SHOT events, and LOADOUT remain separate records.
vault.educationalRefAllValues: Enter all four values to view a text reference timeline.
vault.educationalRefCopy: Map a user-entered dose progression as a text timeline. This stores no protocol and makes no recommendation.
vault.educationalRefDisclaimer: This is not a dosing recommendation. Titration schedules vary by individual protocol. Verify with prescribing guidance.
vault.educationalRefInvalid: Enter a current dose, positive step, whole-week interval, and target at or above the current dose.
vault.educationalRefTooManySteps: This range creates too many steps to display. Increase the step or lower the target.
vault.enterPositiveValue: ENTER AT LEAST ONE POSITIVE VALUE
vault.hapticsHelp: Vibration confirms saves, locks, and selections when the device supports it.
vault.hapticsOff: OFF — silent confirmation. Tap to enable.
vault.hapticsOn: ON — save and lock actions vibrate briefly.
vault.hapticsUnsupported: Not supported on this device. Tap to run a vibration probe.
vault.importDataHelp: Bring history from Shotsy or CSV
vault.localOnlyFooter: Your data stays on this device.
vault.measurementsCopy: Use this profile section as the single entry point for weight and user-entered body measurements.
vault.preferencesCopy: These choices stay local until you choose cloud sync.
vault.systemUpdateNoteClinical: Clinical comparison remains off until reference data is verified.
vault.systemUpdateNotePhase: Phase language stays educational and grounded in user-entered history.
vault.systemUpdateNoteWeight: Weight charts distinguish SHOTS, dose changes, and personal milestones.
vault.systemUpdateNotes: 0.12.0 — Medication identity, first-SHOT continuity, mobile Back behavior, bilingual display, and real-phone readability are production-gated.
